data.comment:
# Comfy FLUX 3 Video- Image to Video

Generate full videos from a single text prompt using FLUX 3, which automatically expands your description into a cohesive scene with synchronized audio, motion, and physics. Outputs one 720p, 24fps MP4 video (5-20 seconds) with support for multi-shot structures and aspect ratios from 9:16 to 21:9. Ideal for product photography, filmic ad campaigns, and dynamic motion graphics. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bfl_flux3_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: ONE continuous unbroken real-time shot, constant motion, no freezing, the action never stops: the camera holds on the red desert caravan beneath the giant ringed planet, then fireballs start raining from the sky, meteor trails streaking past the lens. The camels panic and scatter, dust exploding around their hooves, as the first meteors slam into the dunes. The camera sweeps up toward the hovering mothership just as a meteor tears through its hull, the ship tilts and erupts in a bloom of fire, debris raining down. Ending close on burning wreckage falling toward the desert as the ground shakes. Audio in layers: a low rumble building into deafening meteor strikes and explosions, camel cries and thundering hooves, the mothership's engines screaming into a final blast. Photorealistic, cinematic, smoke and embers drifting past the lens. No on-screen text, no subtitles.
